name: Combinatorial Pairwise Interaction Defect: DarkMode + RTL
description: Tests verified DarkMode independently and RTL independently, but never tested the combination where CSS variable margin-inline-start inverted incorrectly.

failure_vector.error_log: AssertionError: Element offset (-40px) overflows screen when Theme=Dark and Dir=RTL

expected_resolution.healed_code:
@pytest.mark.parametrize('theme,dir', [('light','ltr'), ('light','rtl'), ('dark','ltr'), ('dark','rtl')])
def test_ui_pairwise(theme, dir): assert render_page(theme, dir).is_valid()
